value.message: The comparison helps you to understand the attributes such as User ID, email, Department along with roles and group entitlements. The comparison is a static comparison, and you should run a full evaluation to fix an access issue.
The Details tab displays the metadata associated to user 1 and user 2.
From the Roles tab, you can check the role that needs to be granted for the user and assign that role.
From the Groups tab, you can check the group the user needs to be added and add the user to the group.
When you enable the Show differences only checkbox, only the role or group that is different between the user 1 and user 2 is displayed.
